body.summary: Commit/build/deploy the tested source, safely update/restart the daemon after checking other sessions, and run one deliberate serial control/restricted pair per mode with persisted request IDs. Export real completed candidates and prepare current mode-specific canonical probe records.
acceptanceChecks: Installed source-only and indexed-impact attempts both reach completed with independently validated candidates on exact current source/binary/model/profile pins; failed/unsupported is not task acceptance.
Actual controls fire, restricted native inventory/source policy and all bases pass, two durable ACKs precede actual cancellation/exit; no automatic retries.
Record actual known/unknown usage honestly and retain bounded private raw evidence. Prepare concrete mode-specific records for explicit approval without autoapproving them.
Do not interrupt another session's active reviews/work during daemon deployment; no credential copies or user-global CLI settings edits.

tests.name: Installed source-only and indexed-impact probes each complete with a validated candidate using one serial control restricted pair
